pages.lesson:
LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 10.3.1 DETERMINERS: NUMERALS AND ORDINALS

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 10
Topic 10.3: Grammar in Use 10.3.1 Determiners: Numerals and Ordinals

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Grammar in Use 10.3.1 Determiners: Numerals and Ordinals. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: How are quantities of nouns expressed?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify numerals and ordinals used as determiners in a text
2. use numerals and ordinals as determiners in sentences

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify numerals and ordinals used as determiners in a text
   In simple words: practise until you can identify numerals and ordinals used as determiners in a text. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. use numerals and ordinals as determiners in sentences
   In simple words: practise until you can use numerals and ordinals as determiners in sentences. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Grammar in Use 10.3.1 Determiners: Numerals and Ordinals using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Grammar in Use 10.3.1 Determiners: Numerals and Ordinals in the examples.
2. Explain Grammar in Use 10.3.1 Determiners: Numerals and Ordinals to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Grammar in Use 10.3.1 Determiners: Numerals and Ordinals.
4. Show that you can: identify numerals and ordinals used as determiners in a text

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Grammar in Use 10.3.1 Determiners: Numerals and Ordinals using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Grammar in Use 10.3.1 Determiners: Numerals and Ordinals important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Recite poems with numerals and ordinals as others listen and pick out the target determiners,
2. In small groups, read short passages and underline numerals and ordinals used as determiners,
3. Mention objects in the school that could be modified using numerals and ordinals,
4. Construct sentences using numerals and ordinals,
5. Self-efficacy: It is promoted as the learner correctly uses numerals and ordinals as determiners in communication.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How are quantities of nouns expressed?
2. Why is it important to quantify nouns?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify numerals and ordinals used as determiners in a text
2. use numerals and ordinals as determiners in sentences

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
